## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The Recension B (Taishō-canon recension) of Bodhiruci II's *Vajra-jvāla* weather-control dhāraṇī sūtra. The principal entry, with the doctrinal and historical discussion, is at [KR6j0221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0221) (T1027A); the present T1027B preserves a parallel transmission descending through the Sòng (大→宋) and Korean (大→甲) editions distinct from the *orig* line of Recension A.

**Abstract**

The two recensions T1027A and T1027B of the *Jīngāng guāngyàn zhǐ fēngyǔ tuóluóní jīng* document a textual divergence within the Chinese transmission of Bodhiruci's weather-control dhāraṇī. The variants are concentrated in the dhāraṇī-orthography (Recension B preserves a Sòng-line spelling normalisation) and in the ritual-prescription appendices, which differ in their specific *mudrā* and *maṇḍala* details. Both recensions descend from Bodhiruci II's eighth-century original; neither is a re-translation. For the full discussion see [KR6j0221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0221).
